g.title: TopLevelDependencies
g.text: Riemann Proof Lean 4 — Top-Level Directory Dependency Graph
Edge A -> B means A imports B (A depends on B) | 175,187 files, 753,261 file imports (96,497 cross-top-dir)
Blue: >=1,000 imports | Slate: 50-999 | Indigo: Main entry chain | Dashed Amber: weaker reverse edge of mutual pair
